title: Aerated Spicy Italian Cucumber Suppli
description: A spicy Italian dish featuring cucumber, served as a solo dinner in a cast-iron skillet, this ovo-vegetarian friendly recipe is a twist on traditional suppli, with an aerated texture from the egg and cheese mixture.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the grated cucumber, parmesan cheese, eggs, flour, spicy italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Heat the olive oil in a 10-inch cast-iron skillet over medium heat.
Pour the cucumber mixture into the skillet and cook for 2 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated broiler and broil for 5 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle the shredded mozzarella cheese on top.
Return the skillet to the oven and broil for an additional 2 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Use a spatula to carefully loosen the edges of the suppli from the skillet.
Slide the suppli out of the skillet onto a plate and serve hot.
